reply: Hi Alex, with your Morrow Desk Filter D2 powered on and the new cartridge installed, hold the indicator button for 8 seconds to reset the cartridge timer. The indicator will turn green when the reset succeeds. Holding the button for 3 seconds only checks the current status; it does not reset the timer. If the indicator remains amber after one 8-second reset attempt, contact support. The amber light alone does not mean you need another cartridge.
observation: The manual clearly distinguishes checking status from resetting the timer. One ambiguity in Alex’s ticket is whether they have already tried an 8-second reset; if so and the light remained amber, the next step is support.
